requirement: Transfer supported DOCX shapes into editable HWPX objects with verified geometry and formatting mapping.

implementation.mapping: The source engine model is independently converted to a validated portable HWPX shape. The receiving HWPX session rechecks the envelope and recomputes the DOCX mapping before using it. Geometry is converted from EMU/points to HWPUNIT; supported fill, stroke, stroke width, rotation, flips, and description are preserved.
implementation.preservation: Source DOCX package bytes and OPC parts remain unchanged. The HWPX target receives one editable native shape with stable document ownership. T009 saves only Contents/section0.xml for the exercised transfer; destination OPC part names, BinData, and unrelated resources remain unchanged. Undo/Redo and fresh-session save/reopen preserve the shape.
implementation.rejections: Floating anchors, custom/freeform/triangle shapes, text boxes, media, actual effects, unknown metadata/envelopes, or a tampered portable payload reject before target mutation. Source spin compensation is accepted only when it exactly corresponds to the zero source wp:effectExtent; nonzero effects remain unsupported.

limitations: This is structured object transfer for the listed inline primitives, not full-document format conversion.
Other shape types, floating objects, text boxes, media, effects, and unknown source structures remain fail-closed.
Wayland, Windows, macOS, and external Office/Hancom reopen were NOT RUN.
Nix-independent portability and committed-root-only reproduction with the preserved user-owned evaluator edit were NOT VERIFIED.
